source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: I'm waiting for the bus at the stop.
The bus is a little late, as always.
There are a lot of people at the stop.

sentences.ar: אני עולה ומוצא מקום ליד החלון.
sentences.en: I get on and find a seat by the window.
On the way I look at the city.
